task: convert a natural-language question to SQL over a travel bookings database

items.question: How many trips go to Italy?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips WHERE country = 'Italy'

items.question: What is the cheapest trip price to Japan?
items.sql: SELECT MIN(price) FROM trips WHERE country = 'Japan'

items.question: List the destinations of trips longer than 7 days.
items.sql: SELECT destination FROM trips WHERE duration_days > 7

items.question: What is the average price of trips to Spain?
items.sql: SELECT AVG(price) FROM trips WHERE country = 'Spain'

items.question: Which trips start in May 2026? List their destinations.
items.sql: SELECT destination FROM trips WHERE start_date LIKE '2026-05%'

items.question: How many seats has Ana Sousa booked in total?
items.sql: SELECT SUM(b.seats) FROM bookings b JOIN travelers t ON b.traveler_id = t.id WHERE t.name = 'Ana Sousa'

items.question: What is the highest rated trip in Italy?
items.sql: SELECT destination FROM trips WHERE country = 'Italy' ORDER BY rating DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: How many bookings does each loyalty tier have?
items.sql: SELECT t.loyalty_tier, COUNT(*) FROM bookings b JOIN travelers t ON b.traveler_id = t.id GROUP BY t.loyalty_tier

items.question: List destinations of trips priced between 800 and 1500 dollars.
items.sql: SELECT destination FROM trips WHERE price BETWEEN 800 AND 1500

items.question: Which travelers have booked a trip to Japan?
items.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.name FROM travelers t JOIN bookings b ON b.traveler_id = t.id JOIN trips tr ON b.trip_id = tr.id WHERE tr.country = 'Japan'

items.question: What is the total price of all trips to Italy?
items.sql: SELECT SUM(price) FROM trips WHERE country = 'Italy'

items.question: How many trips last at most 5 days?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips WHERE duration_days <= 5

items.question: List the names of gold-tier travelers.
items.sql: SELECT name FROM travelers WHERE loyalty_tier = 'gold'

items.question: Which destination has the longest trip?
items.sql: SELECT destination FROM trips ORDER BY duration_days DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: How many trips does each country offer?
items.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM trips GROUP BY country
